trust_status: proposed fixed provider spelling; actual issuer/provider/signer must be qualified before enrollment

claims.arrays: explicit, duplicate-free, bounded arrays; no wildcard, coercion, sorting, truncation or silent deduplication; empty means no grant
claims.json: reject duplicate object keys at every level and noninteger/bool time claims; reject unknown holonet_* fields
claims.time: require integer iat and exp, 0 < exp-iat <= 300, iat <= now+30 and now < exp+30; optional nbf must be integer with iat <= nbf < exp and nbf <= now+30
claims.subject: 1..128 printable ASCII bytes, no whitespace or control characters
claims.scopes: space-delimited nonempty distinct known scope names, exactly one ASCII space between names; requested scope never substitutes for issued scope

object.share.qualification: complete explicit audience and private-history release policy required

object.delete.qualification: managed object only; never media item delete

home.manage.qualification: stable ID ownership and client rendering proof required

enforcement: valid JWT intersect signed grants intersect current operator policy intersect backend user restrictions intersect ownership intersect action
all grants bind one configured holonet_server; no request chooses a broader backend/user
catalog user context does not grant userdata/history disclosure; strip UserData unless separately authorized
cache/cursor/journal bind complete effective authority, policy revision and request/run context
sharing must not widen playback, publish private explanations or substitute global public for selected audience
no mutation enabled until qualified installed API and named operator authority
scope combinations emit each claim once; test all 7 nonempty combinations and every ordering against final merged issuer output

forbidden_dispatch.path: unregistered method/path or arbitrary URL, SQL, shell, filesystem path

qualification: Candidate contract data for enrollment/helper/service consumers. No consumer or runtime activation is claimed. Forbidden vectors apply to HoloNet service adapters; the preexisting Ansible preference/library reconciler is a separate operator path.
